name: Election type
description: What kind of electoral event this is. Includes referendums and recalls, which are elections in every practical sense - they are administered the same way and reported in the same form - even though no office is filled.

hasDefinedTerm.name: General
hasDefinedTerm.description: The scheduled election at which offices fall due.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Primary
hasDefinedTerm.description: A contest to select a party's candidates.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Runoff
hasDefinedTerm.description: A second round following an inconclusive first.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Special
hasDefinedTerm.description: An unscheduled election, typically to fill a vacancy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: By-election
hasDefinedTerm.description: An election for a single seat vacated mid-term. The Commonwealth term for a special election.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Referendum
hasDefinedTerm.description: A question put directly to voters.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recall
hasDefinedTerm.description: A vote on removing an officeholder before their term ends.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Indirect
hasDefinedTerm.description: Selection by an electoral college or sitting body.
